verdict.rationale: Scheduled or recurring tasks are a fair axis for an AI assistant, but nothing in the evidence documents scheduling tasks, one-off or recurring, to run automatically and return results. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: Cowork handles on-demand multi-step tasks, the 'hand off repetitive work' and 'automate repetitive tasks' lines are generic marketing, and proactive research suggestions are not user-scheduled tasks.
